description: This file defines the DiffOpOutputBuilder class, which implements methods to convert diff arrays into DiffOp objects and serialize diffs, as well as manage diff operations for a Drupal component.

classes.name: DiffOpOutputBuilder
classes.description: Final class implementing DiffOutputBuilderInterface to generate diff operations and serialize diff arrays.

methods.name: getDiff
methods.description: Serializes the diff array into a string.

methods.name: toOpsArray
methods.description: Converts a diff array into an array of DiffOp objects.

methods.name: hunkOp
methods.description: Creates specific DiffOp objects based on the diff mode.
